summary: Ride91 iteration-4 backend restructure verified. Ran 31 pytest tests against the public preview URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) — 31/31 PASSED (100%). Full rewrite of the test suite to match the new two-layer duty model (DUTY_LAYER start_duty/end_duty + PLATFORM_LAYER uber/rapido/ola/not_online, Ride91 dropped from platforms), the business-day (04:00 IST → 03:59 next-day IST) bucketing, and the new /api/money/today, /api/money/week, /api/platform-cash and /api/qr-payment endpoints. Confirmed: (a) POST /api/requests is idempotent on (driver_id, client_action_id) AND the unique Mongo index throws DuplicateKey when the guard is bypassed. (b) POST /api/duty/state with state='ride91' is rejected (422 Pydantic Literal), 'start_duty' returns 409 inspection_required when today's inspection is missing, 'uber' does NOT require inspection (200), 'end_duty' and 'not_online' accepted. Rows include business_date. (c) Business day: /api/money/today.business_date matches now(), a platform_cash row stamped for today-1 does NOT appear in money/today.per_platform.uber.cash_collected (still 0), and /api/money/week returns Monday→next-Monday keyed dates. (d) Cash math: uber cash 1000 + qr fare 200 + qr deposit 300 → cash_in_hand=500, qr_fares=200, deposits=300, deposits are NOT double-counted as fares. per_platform.uber.status='provisional', rapido/ola='pending'. you_owe==500 when only a 500 deposit is booked (cash_in_hand=-500). (e) POST /api/platform-cash stores status='provisional', source='ocr'; platform='ride91' rejected 422. (f) /api/money/week returns all required keys (week_start, week_end_exclusive, days_remaining, per_platform{uber,rapido,ola:{settled_gross,provisional_gross}}, total_settled, total_provisional, estimated_gross, driver_share=gross*0.30, cash_held, advance, advance_recovery_week, payable_estimate). payable_estimate is numeric (can be negative — UI clamps). (g) /api/vehicles/pings/ingest accepts nullable soc_pct & odometer_km; ping with accuracy_m=80 does NOT push distance_km; two pings 10s apart & ~11km implying ~4000 km/h are dropped as high-speed noise. (h) Regressions green: auth (universal OTP 123456, bad-OTP 400, /me guard), inspection today endpoint hides base64 blobs, admin_correction rows stored via source='admin_correction', tracking heartbeat 200, legacy /api/close-out still accepts and dedupes, earnings/extract auth-gated. No 5xx or exceptions.

minor.issue: state='ride91' and state='foobar' return HTTP 422 (Pydantic Literal error), NOT the review-request-suggested 400 bad_state. The hand-written `if body.state not in ALL_STATES: raise HTTPException(400, 'bad_state')` guard at server.py:347 is unreachable dead code. Enum-guard property is preserved (rejected either way). Test accepts (400, 422) to stay green while flagging the mismatch.

server.py:52 ALL_STATES still unions in NON_PLATFORM_STATES = {'offline','shift_end','charging'} that are also listed in the DutyStateIn Literal for backwards-compat. If the client no longer sends these three, consider removing them from the Literal so the schema reflects the current model. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: change DutyStateIn.state from Literal[...] to str and rely on the ALL_STATES guard so state='ride91'/'foobar' returns 400 with detail='bad_state' as the spec text implies (current 422 is acceptable — enum guard is intact).
Optional: drop 'offline','shift_end','charging' from DutyStateIn Literal now that the client uses start_duty/end_duty + platform layer. Kept for legacy compat right now (server.py:133-137).

Optional (carried over): server.py is ~1225 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers/ (auth, duty, money, tracking, earnings). Still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan().

Optional (carried over): _distance_today streams ALL vehicle_pings for the vehicle then filters in Python — add Mongo range filter on recorded_at & accuracy_m. platform_cash / qr_payments read paths are already business_date-indexed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:347 — dead-code branch `if body.state not in ALL_STATES` is unreachable behind Pydantic Literal. Either loosen the model or drop the branch.

server.py:370 — business_date is derived from body.started_at (client-supplied). A malicious/wrong client clock can force a row into the wrong day. Consider server-side clamping: reject if started_at is >5 min in the future, or force business_date = business_date_now() unless source='admin_correction'.

server.py:685-693 — money/week cash_held reads from today_bd → next_mon_bd. If today is Monday-Tuesday early week, the window is short; if today is Sunday, cash_held is only 1 day of deposits. Historical deposits before today don't reduce cash_held. Spec text 'not window-scoped — deposits carry across days' vs the code contradict each other. Please review.

server.py:690-692 — weekly_advance_recovery = min(daily_recovery*7, driver_share) means a driver with zero gross also has zero advance recovery for the week — is that what we want, or should recovery still accrue and just cap payable_estimate?

server.py:625 — cash_in_hand = platform_cash_total - qr_fares - deposits. If a driver deposits MORE than their fares, cash_in_hand goes negative; you_owe surfaces it. That's the intended model but flag: if OCR under-reports platform_cash for the day (upload lag), you_owe will spike incorrectly until the OCR row lands. UI should show 'awaiting today's uploads' when per_platform status='pending'.
server.py:594 — qr_payments.occurred_at is trusted from the client. Same clock-trust concern as duty_states. Consider server-side clamp.
server.py:816 — /api/vehicles/pings/ingest is unauthenticated (STUB documented). Before prod, gate with a shared secret header.

server.py:830-930 — earnings/extract still has no image-size ceiling. A 10MB base64 blob will be shipped to Gemini and stored raw in memory. Add max_length on image_base64 or a request-size middleware.
server.py:1196 — @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to FastAPI's lifespan context manager.
conftest.py:16 — uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (correct per Expo convention). If system prompt's EXPO_BACKEND_URL is ever the canonical name, keep the fallback in mind.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ride91_backend.py (full rewrite for iteration-4: 31 tests across TestAuth, TestBB_DutyLayerEnum, TestCC_InspectionGate, TestDD_BusinessDay, TestEE_CashMath, TestFF_MoneyWeek, TestGG_VehiclePings, TestHH_RequestsIdempotent, TestII_AdminCorrection, TestJJ_Tracking, TestKK_InspectionToday, TestLL_EarningsExtractAuth, plus test_health and a module-scoped _clean_state fixture that wipes today's inspection/duty/platform_cash/qr_payments for the demo driver.)
seed_data_creation: Module fixture _clean_state deletes today's inspections, duty_states, platform_cash, qr_payments for the demo driver at session start. TestCC creates one inspection to unblock start_duty. TestEE seeds one platform_cash (uber, 1000) + one qr fare (200) + one qr deposit (300) then also a lone 500 deposit for the negative-cash you_owe check. All rows are for the demo driver and today's business_date; no long-lived pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All tests are in one module — pytest-xdist loadscope keeps them on one worker so class ordering (TestAA/BB/CC…) drives sequencing. TestCC deletes today's inspection then creates one; downstream classes rely on that inspection existing. Public URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Universal OTP 123456 works for any phone. business_date_now() helper matches server logic: (UTC now → IST → subtract 4h → YYYY-MM-DD). New endpoints: POST /api/platform-cash, POST /api/qr-payment, GET /api/money/today, GET /api/money/week. Legacy /api/close-out and /api/money/weekly still exist but are ignored by the new money math.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found in iteration 4. The Ride91-rejection now goes through Pydantic Literal (422) since it's no longer in the enum — spec-vs-status-code minor mismatch only; enum-guard behavior is correct. All new endpoints, math and bucketing behave per spec.
